title: Targeting LTBP2 Reveals a Novel Anti-Cardiac Remodeling Mechanism of Finerenone Against Doxorubicin-Induced Cardiotoxicity.
authors: Zhang, Heng; Zhao, Nan; Xie, Saiyang; Li, Lanlan; Zeng, Xiaofeng; Wang, Shasha; Yan, Ling; Shen, Bo; Deng, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Finerenone通过分子对接预测结合LTBP2蛋白抑制TGF-beta通路改善心脏毒性，仅涉及蛋白-小分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Despite the clinical efficacy of doxorubicin (DOX), effective strategies to prevent its cardiotoxicity are still lacking. Finerenone, a nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist (MRA), has demonstrated cardioprotective properties; however, its role and mechanism in DOX-induced cardiotoxicity (DIC) remain unclear. In this study, Finerenone treatment was found to significantly alleviate DOX-induced cardiac dysfunction and pathological remodeling in both mouse models and cultured cells. Mechanistically, molecular docking suggests that Finerenone may directly bind to Latent Transforming Growth Factor Beta Binding Protein 2 (LTBP2), a key regulator of TGF-beta bioavailability. This potential binding could inhibit the LTBP2-TGF-beta axis, thereby suppressing DOX-induced activation and subsequent Smad3 phosphorylation. The importance of this pathway was supported by the similar anti-fibrotic effects observed with the TGF-beta inhibitor LY2109761. However, our findings on the direct binding of Finerenone to LTBP2 are preliminary and require further validation through additional experimental approaches. These results identify LTBP2 as a novel direct target of Finerenone and reveal an additional mechanism underlying its cardioprotective action, suggesting its potential repurposing for the prevention of DIC.
abstract_zh: 尽管阿霉素（DOX）在临床上具有疗效，但预防其心脏毒性的有效策略仍然缺乏。非奈利酮（Finerenone）作为一种非甾体类盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂（MRA），已显示出心脏保护特性；然而，其在DOX诱导的心脏毒性（DIC）中的作用及机制仍不清楚。在本研究中，发现非奈利酮治疗能显著缓解DOX诱导的小鼠模型和培养细胞中的心脏功能障碍及病理重塑。机制上，分子对接提示非奈利酮可能直接结合潜伏转化生长因子β结合蛋白2（LTBP2），该蛋白是TGF-β生物利用度的关键调节因子。这种潜在结合可能抑制LTBP2-TGF-β轴，从而抑制DOX诱导的激活及随后的Smad3磷酸化。该通路的重要性得到了TGF-β抑制剂LY2109761观察到的类似抗纤维化效应的支持。然而，我们关于非奈利酮直接结合LTBP2的发现是初步的，需要通过额外的实验方法进一步验证。这些结果将LTBP2鉴定为非奈利酮的新型直接靶点，并揭示了其心脏保护作用背后的额外机制，提示其可能被重新用于预防DIC。
